properties.description:
Cut 2026-10-05, approved by Anthony Sligar as the "VS Code works well" release. Ships #647 and #680-#685: a guide to reflow2 from VS Code's Copilot agent through the --call door (#647), reflow2 init --harness vscode-cli installing the terminal route under .github/ (#680), loop_status saying when a design was never exported and whose work is unexported (#682), a store's identity file following its real path (#683), a tool surface that tells the truth with --args @file and the pin that the MCP surface only grows (#684), and one-shot opens reporting their version verdict with install.sh keeping a rollback point (#685).

MINOR. THE SCHEMA STAMP DOES NOT MOVE: 28 node types, 66 edge types and 69 enum vocabularies are identical to 0.79.0's, and no schema property changed. No upgrade note is owed. The MCP surface only grew: tests/the_mcp_surface_only_grows.rs compares the build with 0.79.0's tools, argument schemas and reply shapes.

WHAT A CONSUMER OR OPERATOR SHOULD KNOW:
- VS Code with MCP blocked: upgrade with tools/install.sh, run reflow2 init . --harness vscode-cli, commit .github/, add the chat.tools.terminal.autoApprove setting for /^reflow2 read /, and delete the hand-written user instructions file.
- On MCP, nothing to do; every surface change is additive, and an MCP init or update writes what it wrote before.
- install.sh keeps the replaced binary as reflow2-mcp.<old version> for a rollback. Measured at this cut: the published 0.79.0 binary refuses a 0.80.0 export by default (stamped newer); with --accept-newer it imports all 6,761 nodes and 44,732 edges of reflow2's own design.
- loop_status may open with THIS DESIGN HAS NEVER BEEN EXPORTED or an ahead_of_export line; run the command it names.
- A store refused as having lost its identity file recovers when <store>.id.json is put beside it.
properties.name: v0.80.0 — VS Code works well: the terminal route installed by init, a loop that says what is not exported, and a surface that only grows
